literal_owner_messages.t38u: a assinatira da priimeira versao sera feita pelo github conforme regras

requirements: native Slicer/server updates from the first distribution and for every future version
sign first version through GitHub according to the documented rules; provenance is not automatically Windows code signing or an ECDSA manifest
show cumulative release notes in the app; preserve confirmation, unsaved work and safe automatic close/reopen
first download restricted to legitimately authorized beta/admin users, never a hidden public link
keep no more than five logical installer versions, not five files or five per channel
preserve documentary history, notes, hashes and audit records even after old installer bytes are pruned
compile and generate another installer only if a real version change requires it
resume general implementation/homologation only after native integration is proven; no automatic gate promotion
